rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=32, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-13 (one knob vs iter-12 best). NUMBERS n_bands(n_outer1): 8->RMSE0.005260, 12->0.005089(hr0.0240), 16->0.005074(hr0.0268), 24->0.005058(hr0.0299 iter-12 BEST). RMSE still declining but decelerating; hr monotone up 0.0240->0.0268->0.0299. SSIM eroding 0.933->0.925 (finer bands trade SSIM for RMSE; hr rewards RMSE). FAILURE MODE: band-resolution ceiling approaching; each doubling now buys ~0.003 hr. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 24 -> 32 (n_outer/thresh/motion locked). HYPOTHESIS: if hr rises past 0.0299 the band optimum is >=32 (I lock a high count and pivot to re-optimising soft_thresh/n_outer at that high-band point where their optima may have shifted); if hr plateaus/falls, n_bands=24 is the practical optimum and I pivot. Budget: 32 bands ~ 2x iter-11 back-projection cost, still << 20min (classical, seconds).
